units.source_text: 在这里，希望大家不要误解，松之绿绝对不是成药。

en.t: Here, I hope everyone will not misunderstand: Matsunomidori is absolutely not a patent medicine.

units.source_text: 所谓成药就是获得内务省的许可，而且被配制成不起疗效的药物。

en.t: A so-called patent medicine is one that has received permission from the Ministry of Home Affairs and is compounded so that it has no real therapeutic effect.

units.source_text: 不是把病治好，只是把病暂时压下去而已。

en.t: It does not cure the illness; it merely suppresses it for a while.

units.source_text: 可是这个松之绿，它是食品，而且具有治病的效果。

en.t: But this Matsunomidori is a food, and it also has the effect of curing illness.
